why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. (1) Verifier Check 6 bases PASS/FAIL on `npm test; echo "exit=$?"` and the grep plus reading of the test, not on `npm run test:cli`. The only mention of test:cli is in the Advisory section, which is explicitly "not part of PASS or FAIL". The builder brief asks for a test:cli script, but that is a builder step, not a verifier check. (2) The builder brief never asks for a general separator option. It says "Do not add --help, --sep/--delimiter, auto-detection..." and only adds the --tsv check on process.argv. Neither forbidden item appears anywhere in the output.
